fact: The Gambia Public Procurement Authority training of 8-10 October 2026 covers the rollout of the Electronic Government Procurement (E-GP) system, which the GPPA Board Vice Chairperson says will digitise the procurement cycle.

GPPA Director General Phoday Jaiteh reports that over the past two years the authority has developed regulations, a procurement manual and bidding documents and implemented a new e-procurement portal, streamlining the business registration process and reducing transaction times.
